notices.title: [합성] Export licence for every shipment of rare-earth magnet parts from China
notices.content: [합성] From 2026-03-01, every shipment of rare-earth permanent magnets and parts containing them, including magnets built into production equipment, exported from China needs its own export licence, and shipments without a licence cannot clear customs. Licence review may take up to 60 days after application.

notices.title: [합성] Work-permit verification for non-EU equipment installation technicians
notices.content: [합성] From 2026-11-01, companies bringing technicians from outside the EU to install or commission production equipment must obtain a work-permit verification for each technician before site work starts. Authorities may take up to 30 days to verify an application. Transitional arrangements are not yet confirmed.

notices.title: [합성] Local regulatory approval backlog in Hungary
notices.content: [합성] 헝가리 지방정부 인허가 접수분의 처리 기간이 2025-10-01부터 최대 45일 늘어날 수 있습니다. Local regulatory approval backlog.
